name: Rename by hierarchy
author: Lienzo UI
description: Names elements after their parents (Parent_Child) and fixes duplicated names, so the Unity hierarchy is clean.

commands.name: Prefix names with parents
commands.description: Renames each element as Parent_Child, using its whole chain of ancestors. Safe to run twice.

commands.name: Make names unique
commands.description: Adds a number to repeated names (Button, Button 2, Button 3...).
